sources.snippet: Project Overview LoomVision AI is a real-time system that captures live fabric images directly from a mobile phone camera and detects manufacturing defects such as broken threads, loose weaves, and stains. Built primarily for handloom workers, it features a split-cloud architecture with a lightweight Vercel Frontend and a heavy deep-learning Flask/Render Backend.
